## Games

### ALBA Berlin crushes Phoenix Hagen 102:72 in BBL matchup

*Played Friday, 06 November 2026*

ALBA Berlin dominated Phoenix Hagen in a 102:72 victory at the Uber Arena. The Berliners struggled in the first half, but adjusted their game in the second half, taking control with a strong outside shooting performance. Phoenix Hagen's Chris Harris attributed their loss to too many turnovers and difficulties handling the opposing team's pressure. Harris also praised the team's performance in the first half, saying they had been in agreement with the game's progression until Berlin took control. Marvin Omuvwie of Phoenix Hagen noted that the team had wanted to take more things away from Berlin in the second half, but were unable to do so. ALBA Berlin's Julius Böhmer praised the team's defensive effort, saying they had been able to apply pressure on the opposing team and limit their scoring opportunities. The win marks ALBA Berlin's fourth home victory of the season, and they will face Phoenix Hagen again in the BBL playoffs on December 13.

### Bonn Hosts Braunschweig in Crucial EasyCredit BBL Matchup

*Played Saturday, 07 November 2026*

The Telekom Baskets Bonn will face the Basketball Löwen Braunschweig at the Telekom Dome on November 7th at 20:00 UTC. Bonn is looking to extend their winning streak to four games, while Braunschweig seeks to end their four-game losing streak. Braunschweig's Devin Askew, averaging 17.3 points per game, will be absent due to injury. Bonn's John-Michael Wright is the team's top scorer, averaging 15.6 points per game, including 19.5 points per game at home. The game will be broadcast live by Dyn. Tickets are available online in advance.

## European Cups

### Würzburg's winning streak faces tough test against Bayern Munich

Würzburg's Fitness First Baskets are riding a six-game winning streak, with their last six wins coming in a grueling October schedule that saw them play nine games in 29 days. The team, led by coach Sasa Filipovski, has found success after a slow start to the season, which included three consecutive away losses. Bayern Munich, on the other hand, has struggled in recent weeks, losing three games in a row and ending the month with a negative record of 5-6. However, the team has bounced back with wins over Braunschweig and ASVEL in the EuroLeague. The two teams have a long history, with Bayern Munich holding a 27-4 edge in their 31 head-to-head BBL matchups. Würzburg's last win over Bayern was a 90-70 victory at home on November 2, 2021. The game will be streamed live on the SPORTBILD website.

### Tabellendritter SYNTAINICS MBC hosts table fourth SKYLINERS

The SYNTAINICS MBC, third in the easyCredit BBL table, hosts the SKYLINERS, fourth in the table, in a highly anticipated matchup. The two teams have met 15 times before, with the SYNTAINICS MBC winning their last three home games. The SKYLINERS have a strong away record, having won in Hagen and Jena, and are also in the quarterfinals of the Netto BBL Pokal after beating Trier 78-65. The SYNTAINICS MBC has the lowest turnover rate in the league, with 9.9 per game, while the SKYLINERS have the best free throw percentage, 82.6%. The game features two of the league's top scorers, Spencer Reaves of the SYNTAINICS MBC with 23.3 points per game and Judah Mintz of the SKYLINERS with 18.4 points per game.

### SKYLINERS and SYNTAINICS MBC clash in surprise matchup

The SKYLINERS and SYNTAINICS MBC, two of the biggest surprises in the easyCredit BBL, will face off on Sunday afternoon. The SKYLINERS, with a 4-1 record, have played two fewer games than the SYNTAINICS MBC, who have a 5-2 record. Both teams have won four consecutive games, with the SKYLINERS having lost only to Berlin and the SYNTAINICS MBC having lost only to Bonn and Oldenburg. The matchup will also feature a duel between top scorers, with Spencer Reaves of the SKYLINERS averaging 23.3 points per game, and Judah Mintz of the SYNTAINICS MBC averaging 18.3 points per game with a strong shooting percentage of 58.9%.

### Bamberg Baskets face tough test at VET-CONCEPT Gladiators Trier

The Bamberg Baskets are set to face a challenging task in their 8th game of the easyCredit Basketball Bundesliga season, as they travel to Trier to face the VET-CONCEPT Gladiators. The Gladiators, who have won five games in a row, are currently second in the BBL table and have been dominant in the FIBA Europe Cup, winning all five of their games in Group A. Trier's strength this season can be attributed to their ability to retain a large part of their playoff team from last year, including Hollersbacher, Linßen, Yakhchali, Rapieque, Guillozet, Zirbes, and Roland. The Bamberg Baskets, led by Head Coach Jesús Ramírez, will be looking to overcome the Gladiators' strong form and secure a win.

### Rostock Seawolves face tough test against Lok Bernau

The Rostock Seawolves Academy will travel to Lok Bernau for their 7th game of the BARMER 2. Basketball Bundesliga ProB Nord season. The match, scheduled for Saturday, November 7th at 19:00 in the Sparkassen-Arena Bernau, will see the 8th-placed Seawolves face off against 4th-placed Lok Bernau, who are considered a top contender for promotion. Lok Bernau boasts a strong individual team with many young talents, including Stefan Peno and Adam Pechacek. Coach Domenik Reinboth notes that Lok Bernau will likely be motivated to bounce back from their recent loss to Hagen (69:91), and the Seawolves will need to withstand their aggressive pressure. The match will be live-streamed on sporteurope.tv.

### Tylan Pope's Suspension Reduced to Two Games and €4,000 Fine

The easyCredit BBL's referee, Dirk Horstmann, has granted the appeal of EWE Baskets Oldenburg's Tylan Pope, reducing his initial suspension from three games to two and his fine from €2,000 to €4,000. The referee cited the principle of proportionality, comparing it to a recent decision in the case of Cobe Williams, and took into account the heated nature of the game, the preceding physical contact, and the verbal altercation between the two players. Pope's clean past and immediate apology were also considered. The decision was made to avoid a hearing at the Schiedsgericht, as allowed by Paragraph 10 and 11 of the Verfahren- und Schiedsgerichtsordnung.
